name: Ideal.mapCotangent_ker_of_surjective
statement: Function.Surjective (algebraMap A B)) {I : Ideal B} {J : Ideal A} (eq : I.comap (algebraMap A B) = RingHom.ker (algebraMap A B) ⊔ J) : (Ideal.mapCotangent J I (Algebra.ofId A B) (le_of_le_of_eq le_sup_right eq.symm)).ker = (Submodule.comap J.subtype ((RingHom.ker (algebraMap A B)) ⊓ J)).map J.toCotangent
